column1: # drop: round 1 of the review (5,000 most frequent senses), after the guards and a hand review — see corrections.mjs

column4: 'Geen' does not mean 'yonder'; that sense comes only from the fixed phrase 'gene zijde' (from archaic 'gene'), so it is wrong and confusing.
'nu' as a noun is het, not de, and this meaning duplicates the 'het nu' entry.
'Shortly' is a poor sense of 'even' and duplicates the 'for a moment/short period' meanings.
'Weer' as resistance or defense is archaic (in 'te weer staan', 'zich te weer stellen') and duplicates the 'defense' meaning already listed.
'Uit zijn doen' is an archaic fixed phrase, and 'het doen' as a noun meaning routine only confuses learners.
The sense "reversion/turn" is rare and the example is unnatural; it confuses learners compared with the main meaning "time".
This meaning duplicates the other listed meaning 'to find (after searching)'.
It duplicates the other 'sorry' entry, which is the more specific one for expressing regret.
The meaning 'a little' is already listed for beetje, so this 'bit of' sense duplicates it.
The plain 'open' sense duplicates the other listed open meanings and is the basic sense, but this entry adds nothing distinct from the other open senses.
This archaic noun sense (colour of lead) is obscure and only confuses a learner.
The archaic noun "blij" for lead is obscure; the modern word is lood, so it would only confuse a learner.
To pause is essentially the same as the idiom's other meaning 'to mark time' (halt in place), so it duplicates it and is misleading.
Hurt duplicates the meaning 'pain', which is already listed and matches the example.
The meaning 'board' (as in room and board) is not a real standalone sense of kamer, so it is confusing.
An archaic sense glossed 'special' does not exist for the noun kamer and would only confuse learners.
Middleman is essentially the same as the broker/agent meaning already listed, so it duplicates it.
eerder as a noun meaning plower is not a real Dutch word (the word would be 'ploeger'), so the entry is spurious.
groot is an adjective and "grotendeels" or "in grote mate" covers the adverbial sense, so a separate adverb entry glossed "largely" is not a real standalone meaning.
to be necessary duplicates the existing "to need to" / "to need" meanings of hoeven.
'Grave consequence' is not a real standalone meaning of 'bloed' and is obscure or idiomatic at best.
'Whole body' is not a real meaning of 'bloed'; it is only found in rare figurative uses and would confuse a learner.
voorbij as 'past' is already covered by the adverb/preposition entries, and the adjective use is marginal, so this duplicates other meanings.
The motion sense of 'around' duplicates the other 'around' meaning for the adverb.
'Sphere' duplicates the other meanings of 'het rond' such as circle and sphericity, and is rare.
Employer duplicates the existing "boss" meaning, which already covers this sense.
'Corpse' is not the usual meaning of lichaam (that would be 'lijk'), though 'body' covers it, so this meaning duplicates 'body' and is wrong.
Division ring is not a meaning of lichaam; it is a bizarre, wrong sense.
Field is not a normal meaning of lichaam (only in physics jargon, e.g. a heavenly body), and would confuse learners.
Figurehead is not a meaning of gezicht; that would be a different word (boegbeeld).
'Van God los' is an idiom, not a preposition, and 'having loose morals' is a figurative sense that is obscure; the 'without God' entry covers the idiom.
'Hurtful' is an obscure sense that is already covered by 'sore' and 'painful' in this entry.
This archaic sense duplicates 'physical pain' and only confuses learners.
This archaic 'sore spot' sense duplicates the other noun meanings and is of little use to learners.
This archaic noun is obscure and duplicates the meaning 'poem/poetry' already covered by other entries.
'Branch' is not a standard meaning of 'wapen' (the weapon meaning is already listed, and 'branch of the military' is a stretch), so it would only confuse learners.
to encounter in this sense duplicates the main meaning "to meet", and the example sounds unnatural.
'Film production' duplicates the existing 'film' meaning and is not a distinct sense.
Inspiration is not a standard meaning of "het licht" and is a figurative stretch that only confuses learners.
Eerste persoon is a noun phrase, not an interjection, and it is already listed correctly as a noun in item 4.
Derogatory use for a person is an offensive insult and adds little for a learner beyond the main dog meaning.
Personification of Earth duplicates the main meaning of the planet Earth.
Duplicates the other meaning 'to feel'; the example fits that sense.
'Lopen' as a noun dry measure is obscure/archaic and confusing for learners.
The generic "contact" gloss duplicates the more specific contact meanings already listed.
Distorted is not a normal meaning of verkeerd, which means wrong, and that meaning is already listed.
It duplicates the other meaning "coffee (beverage)" of the same word.
Informal 'ziek' as an intensifier ('very') is slang, and the example uses it in its ordinary meaning 'ill', so this adverb meaning only confuses learners.
'heer' is a de-word meaning lord or gentleman, and 'het heer' for army is an archaic form (modern 'leger'), which only confuses a learner.
to belate is not a meaning of verlaten; it is an archaic, confusing mistranslation.
'Form' is not a real meaning of het leger (army, bed/lair), so this sense does not exist.
'Mass' is not an actual meaning of het leger; it is a spurious sense (the real ones are army and bed/lair).
The 'not often' sense duplicates the 'little' meaning of the adverb, since 'sleeps little' already covers it.
weinig is not normally a noun; "het weinige" is the nominalised form, and this meaning is already covered under the pronoun/numeral entries.
weinig as 'little' is already listed in the other entry with a near-identical meaning, so this one duplicates it.
The archaic meaning 'to please' is obscure and only confuses learners; the common meanings are already listed.
'Van dienst zijn' does not mean taking on a certain role (that would be 'dienst doen als'), so this meaning does not exist.
'Yessir' is not a distinct sense of jawel and duplicates the emphatic 'yes indeed' meaning.
The archaic sense 'absolutist' is obscure and would only confuse a learner; the main meaning 'absolute' is already listed.
'To be sold' is the passive use of 'to sell' and the idiom example belongs under the main meaning, so this duplicates it.
The noun straat does not mean 'straight'; that meaning does not exist for this noun.
hand review: the meaning repeats another one
Which one duplicates the meaning "which" in item 3 and has no example.
This meaning duplicates 'aeroplane' and 'vliegtuig' is not archaic, so the entry is redundant.
The gloss 'past' duplicates the other meaning 'past tense' for this phrase, and the phrase specifically means the grammatical past tense.
Bargain is essentially the same sense as the other listed meaning "deal" (an agreement or good arrangement), so it duplicates it.
Writing tablet is an archaic sense (e.g. stone tablets of the law), too obscure for learners.
Soaring is just a use of 'to fly' and duplicates the main meaning, so it adds nothing for a learner.
The gloss 'bad' is not a real meaning of koud and the genuine senses (cold, unfriendly) are already listed.
'On purpose' is not a meaning of extra (that is 'expres' or 'opzettelijk'); in the sense of 'specially' it is an adverb use already covered by the extra sense.
Temple is not a meaning of kerk (that is tempel), and the real meanings church and religious organization are already listed.
Procedure duplicates the existing operation meaning, and the example is a surgical operation, so this is redundant.
'Expecting a baby together' is not a distinct meaning and duplicates 'pregnant'.
'Bicorne' (steek as a two-cornered hat) is obscure and confusing for learners, while the common meanings remain listed.
This is a small place name (a hamlet) that is of no use to a learner.
The noun is 'de getuige' (witness), which is probably listed separately, and 'het getuige' does not exist as a noun meaning testimony.
Kwalijk does not mean difficult; that sense does not exist.
Bar does not really mean crude in the sense of vulgar, and the sense of extreme is covered by harsh.
The meaning 'bar' (pub serving alcohol) is already covered by the other meaning listed, so this entry duplicates it.
The plain 'sister' meaning duplicates the existing 'sister (female sibling)' entry.
'Toff' is an obscure slang sense of bal (and not vulgar), which would only confuse a learner.
Aandacht does not mean 'affection'; this meaning does not exist.
Aandacht does not mean 'respect'; this meaning does not exist.
The meaning 'completely' is already listed as the adverb sense, and the gloss 'complete' is the adjective; the adjective sense belongs under the adjective entry.
'Parcel' is not a meaning of 'slag', and the entry has no example.
'Self-destruction' is a poor gloss and the meaning duplicates the existing 'suicide' meaning.
'Service point' is not a real meaning of 'winkel' and 'shop' is already listed.
Sled is not a standard meaning of de wagen; the real meanings (wagon, cart, car) are already listed.
To be moved is not a meaning of the verb wagen (to dare); it comes from a confusion with the archaic wegen/bewegen.
To move is not a real meaning of wagen; the verb means to dare or risk, which is already listed.
The gloss '20 °C' is not a translation, and the plain meaning 'warm' is already listed as another meaning.
'rennen' is a verb and 'de rennen' is not a real noun, so this noun meaning does not exist.
'Manager' is not a standard meaning of meester and would only confuse a learner.
'Slave's' is not a real separate meaning; it is a fragment of the 'master' sense (slave owner) and duplicates it.
This is an offensive slur that does not belong in a learner's dictionary.
to prove duplicates the "to indicate" meaning (getuigen van), and it overstates it.
It duplicates the meaning of item 4.
Duplicates the 'taking into account' idiom in the other rekening entry, and 'Reckoning' is a vague gloss.
Archaic sense of 'train' duplicates the existing meaning of the railway vehicle.}
'Monster' does not mean an antisocial person in standard Dutch; this is not a real separate meaning beyond 'monster'.
Flagged as archaic and duplicates the main 'cat' meaning (domestic cat).
'Cavalier' is an obscure, archaic sense of 'kat' that would only confuse learners.
'Feline' duplicates the domestic cat meaning.
Female cat is just a narrower sense of the already-listed domestic cat and duplicates it (kat is generic, poes is the female).
Offset is not a real meaning of afstand a learner needs, and it is obscure compared with the main meaning "distance".
Offstand is not an English word and is a bogus gloss; it is not a meaning of afstand.
Any seat duplicates the main meaning "chair" and is vague.
This vague 'base on which something rests' sense is not a distinct everyday meaning of stoel and is covered by the seat meanings, so it only confuses learners.
'Place of residence' applies to the archaic 'Heilige Stoel' (Holy See) sense, which is too obscure for learners.
'Receptacle' is not a real meaning of stoel as used today and is not helpful to learners.
This is a slur use of the word and duplicates the neutral meaning 'gay' already listed.
This is an offensive ethnic slur, and the example uses the ordinary adjective 'blauw' rather than this meaning.
hand review: the meaning repeats another one
The meaning 'swelling' for opdracht is archaic and obscure and would only confuse a learner.
The archaic meaning 'transfer of possessions' is obscure and not useful for a learner.
mindless is not a real meaning of dol; the sense of mad/wild is already covered by "crazy".
Thole pin and rowlock are the same thing, so this duplicates the other meaning of dol; also the article is het/de ambiguity is unneeded.
This is a vulgar, offensive sense that is better left out, and the main meaning 'box' is already listed.
'Apex' duplicates the 'top (uppermost part)' and 'summit' meanings already listed.
The gloss 'top' duplicates the existing meanings 'top (uppermost part)' and 'summit' of the same noun.
The 'nutrient' meaning is not what voedsel means; it duplicates the other meaning 'food'.
hand review: the meaning repeats another one
The 'jack' sense is archaic and obscure, and 'coat' is already listed as the main meaning.
Slut duplicates the other meaning "whore" for hoer; the article de is correct, so the flag is not the issue, but the sense is redundant.
This is a dubious eggcorn/misuse of bedoening, not a genuine meaning of bedoeling, and would confuse learners.
To arrest is not a real meaning of tegenhouden (it means to stop or hold back), so this sense is wrong and overlaps the existing ones.
'de kamp' as battle is archaic or obscure (the old word 'kamp' for combat survives only in fixed phrases), so it only confuses a learner.
'kamp' as field is an obscure archaic or dialect meaning (de kamp, an enclosed field) that does not help a learner.
'de kamp' as tournament is not a standard meaning of the word; 'kamp' only means contest in archaic usage, so it only confuses a learner.
Archaic meaning (adulterer) of boel that only confuses learners; also near-duplicate of the archaic lover sense.
Archaic 'lover' sense of boel is obscure and not useful for learners.
Quarrel is not a standard meaning of de boel; the word means stuff/mess, so this sense is wrong or obscure.
'Magical' is an adjective sense, not a noun meaning of magie, and the noun is already covered by the 'magic' meaning.
Wellicht means 'perhaps/possibly' and 'probably' is not a distinct meaning, so this duplicates the first entry.
Immersion is a near-duplicate of the act-of-bathing sense and is unnatural for a learner.
The archaic 'pound' entry duplicates the other pound meanings already listed.
The vulgar sense of ballen is a different meaning from ball-play and is not a duplicate, but it is vulgar and mostly confusing for learners, so it is dropped.
This is a technical computing sense that duplicates the general meaning 'signal' and would confuse learners.
'Spicy' is not a standard meaning of 'straf' in the sense of strong drink or food, and it duplicates the 'strong' meaning.
Discomfort is not a real meaning of straf; the only real sense, punishment, is already listed.
The meaning 'media' duplicates the 'press' meaning already listed, and the example fits that one.
'To be on' (e.g. a light or device being on, as in 'staan op') is not a real meaning of opstaan and is vague and confusing.
'To be playing' is not a real meaning of opstaan and is not a standard sense.
Social circle is too close to the existing meanings "company" and "club", so it duplicates them.
Small is not a real meaning of "eng"; it is covered by "narrow" and "scary".
The archaic hoof-front sense is obscure and only confuses a learner, while the common sense 'tone' is already listed.
'Brooder' (a device for hatching chicks) is not an ordinary Dutch meaning of 'broeder' and is obscure and misleading, whereas 'brother' is already listed.
The gloss 'Kip' is not English and this sense duplicates the other listed meanings 'chicken' and 'female chicken'.
'SMS' and 'text message' are the same meaning of 'sms', so this duplicates the other entry.
Any ground is not a real meaning of vloer; it is covered by the floor meaning.
Bottom is not a distinct meaning of vloer and is covered by the floor meaning.
Reden as a verb (to equip a ship, from archaic 'redden' sense) is obscure/archaic and duplicates item 2.
Obscure nautical verb sense that only confuses learners and duplicates item 1; the common verb 'reden' is not this.
The vulgar 'pussy' sense is not the usual meaning of trut (a dull, silly woman) and is offensive and misleading, and 'bitch' and 'boring' already cover the derogatory sense.
'Simplex' is a technical term that confuses learners, and the meanings 'plain' and 'easy' already cover the word.
'Pavillion' is misspelled and is a rare sense of tent, a marquee or party tent being already covered by 'tent'.
Marked archaic but it duplicates the common meaning of talent (gift, capability), and het is already the correct article.
Het station does not mean disk drive; Dutch uses schijfstation or diskdrive, so this meaning is wrong.
'Westwards' is not a distinct meaning of the adverb 'west' here and duplicates the other 'west' sense.
'Joke' is not a normal meaning of bak, so this sense does not exist for a learner.
'Bak' meaning pig is obscure, regional or dated and would only confuse a learner.
Wit is an adjective, not an adverb, and the meaning 'white' is already listed under the right part of speech (white (color) as a noun and adjective).
The gloss is just a stray parenthesis and this archaic meaning is unclear and only confusing for a learner.
Wit meaning wit/intellect is archaic and obscure, and learners would be confused by it.
Archaic meaning of 'wit' (knowledge/wit) that only confuses learners and overlaps with the listed 'ability to think and reason'.
The collective-reactionaries sense is obscure and overlaps with the general meaning of reaction, so it only confuses learners.
'ho' as a noun meaning homosexual is a slur or at best a confusing sense, and the example uses 'ho' as an interjection, which does not match.
'to be acquired' is not a real or current meaning of aankomen and only confuses learners.
'Shoreline' duplicates the 'coast' meaning already listed.
The 'act of bleaching' sense of 'bleek' is obscure and archaic, so it only confuses a learner, and it overlaps with the bleachfield sense.
'Bleach' as a noun is not a normal meaning of 'bleek' (the modern word is 'bleekmiddel'); 'bleek' is mainly an adjective meaning 'pale'.
'Dier' as a pronoun meaning 'her' is a dialectal or archaic form of 'haar' that only confuses learners, and the standard word 'dier' is a noun meaning 'animal'.
The 'drinking place for animals' sense is just the 'wed' (ford/watering place) meaning, so it duplicates the 'ford' sense and is archaic.
Amper is an adverb meaning 'barely/almost' and the adjective sense 'sour' is archaic and wrong, so it only confuses learners.  ('amper' as sour is an obsolete dialect form of 'amer'.)

column3: leg of a piece of furniture
column4: 'Leg of a piece of furniture' is not a real meaning of 'stal' and is rare and confusing.
'Marked period of time' is not a meaning of the noun 'stal' in current Dutch.
'Thin pole' is not a meaning of 'stal' in current Dutch and would only confuse learners.
Electrical current duplicates the existing "electricity" meaning of stroom.
The digraph meaning is a metalinguistic sense of the word, not a real learner meaning, and the example wrongly uses 'de' (the letter combination is 'het ei' anyway).
'Nice' is not a meaning of 'wijs'; the real meaning 'wise' is listed separately.
Personeel is a noun (staff), and the adjective form is personeels or personeelsgebonden, not this word, so it is already covered under the noun.
southern is not an adjective sense of the noun; the meaning duplicates "south" in item 1 and the example is covered by it.
Decorum is not a real meaning of smaak, and the example matches the basic sense "taste" already listed.
This duplicates the other 'witch' meaning listed for the same word.
Liquefied petroleum gas is just a specialized sense of gas (het gas), which is already covered by the general 'gas' meaning.
The meaning 'unpaved street' is a dialect/obscure sense (really 'gasse' or Flemish 'gas' as lane), too obscure and not standard de gas in Netherlands Dutch.
The noun 'het verdacht' is archaic and not a real modern noun; the standard word is 'verdenking', so it only confuses learners.
Nude duplicates the main sense naked, which is better kept as a separate entry, so this is redundant.
water closet is just the expansion of the same meaning as the toilet entry and duplicates it.
'Goods' overlaps with the colloquial 'whole lot/stuff' sense in item 1 and the example shows that same sense, so it is a duplicate.
'Nutmeg' is not a meaning of 'poort'; the meaning does not exist.
The vague gloss 'similar bakery product' is not a distinct meaning and is already covered by 'bread' and 'loaf of bread'.
'Voorbeeld' does not mean 'preview'; that is 'voorproefje' or 'voorvertoning'.
The gloss 'single' is not a meaning of 'markt' and looks like a mis-extracted entry.
'centre (UK)' only duplicates the existing 'centre' meaning as a spelling variant.
'Ramp' does not mean driveway in Dutch (that is 'oprit'), so this meaning does not exist.
It is not an interjection and duplicates the verb entry for 'groen lachen' (to laugh sourly).
'Donder' meaning 'head' only exists in idioms like 'op zijn donder geven' (a beating), not as a standalone meaning, so it is misleading for learners.
A noun 'de fuck' is not a standard Dutch noun and the meaning is already covered by the interjection.
Duplicates the other 'allerlei' entry, which has the same meaning of 'all kinds of'/'various'.
shape is not a real meaning of model here and the other listed meanings already cover model, design, miniature and prototype.
Division ring is an obscure mathematical/heraldic sense that does not belong to het lijf and would only confuse a learner.
Field (as in heraldic field) is not a real everyday meaning of lijf and is obscure.
'To infect' is an obscure sense of verpesten (from pest) that is not the common meaning; 'to spoil' and 'to screw up' already cover it.
Fort means a fortification, not a castle (kasteel), and it duplicates the other fort entry.
'term' is not a meaning of seizoen, and the real meaning 'season' is already listed.
'tensive' is not a real English gloss, and the meanings 'exciting' and 'stressful' already cover spannend.
'human nature' is wrong for mensheid, which means humankind, and the correct meaning 'humanity' is already listed.

column3: As a term for a girl
column4: As a term for a girl is a description rather than a gloss and duplicates the other "girl" meaning.
The "girl" sense duplicates the other girl meanings, and the vulgar tag makes it confusing for learners.
'Hal' as 'frozen ground' is not a real meaning; the only sense is 'hall', which is already listed, and it is 'de hal'.
Temerity duplicates the courage/nerve meaning of lef (as in het gore lef), so it is redundant; the article is het.
To remove is not a real meaning of verplaatsen and overlaps with "to move".
'To engineer' duplicates the sense 'to initiate' (to set up, organize) listed under the same expression.
artificial duplicates the other meaning "fake" for nep.
The gloss is a vague fragment and it duplicates the 'bar on a metal fence' meaning.
Cheque means a bank check; 'voucher' is not a real meaning (that would be bon/waardebon) and the sense is already covered by 'check'.
A fiets is a bicycle, not a motorbike, and the correct meaning is already listed.
'surface' is not a distinct meaning of 'dek' and overlaps with the deck and cover senses.
The 'especially' sense is archaic and confusing, and the real meaning 'namely' is already listed.
Marck is a place name, not a meaning of "merk"; the real meaning (brand) is presumably listed separately.
It duplicates the other meaning 'to concentrate (the mind)', which is the same sense.
A café is not a snackbar; this meaning does not exist and is confusing.
It is the same meaning as item 1, differing only in British versus American spelling.
Zegen as a fishing seine net is a rare technical sense and the gloss describes an activity rather than a meaning, so it only confuses learners.
Zegen has no 'hunting fowl' meaning; this is a garbled or obscure sense that would mislead learners.
The gloss 'mijl' just repeats the headword and is an archaic sense (old Dutch mile) that duplicates the main meaning.
The nautical mile is zeemijl; this archaic entry with a label as gloss duplicates the mile meaning and is confusing.
'Bodem' as 'ship' is an archaic or obscure sense (a hull or vessel) that would only confuse learners.
'Department' is not a real meaning of opname; it seems to be a mistaken variant of the hospital admission sense, which is covered by 'intake'.
'Moving force' is a rare figurative sense that confuses learners and has no example.
'Hub' is not a standard meaning of centrale and it overlaps with the exchange sense, so it only confuses learners.
The meaning 'watch' for rat is obscure and archaic slang that only confuses a learner.
It duplicates item 1, with the same meaning and no example.
The plain 'dry' gloss duplicates the existing 'dry (not wet)' meaning.
De studie is correct, and this 'research' sense duplicates the other listed meanings and is better covered under the general 'study' entry.
death's-head is an obscure figurative use of schedel that duplicates the skull meaning and only confuses learners.
mound's crest is not a real modern meaning of schedel and is obscure or archaic.
The derogatory 'despicable woman' sense is essentially covered by the 'bitch' meaning, so it duplicates it.
'Boot' is not a meaning of 'bot' in Dutch (that is 'laars'); bot means bone (het bot), flounder, or bud, so this is wrong.
Maiden is an archaic sense that overlaps with the "young girl" and "virgin" meanings, so it only duplicates them.
Bekennen does not mean to have sex (that is "bekennen" in the Biblical archaic sense only), and the example actually shows the admit meaning, which duplicates meaning 2.
To see is not a real modern meaning of bekennen; it is archaic or confusing, and has no example.
The sense 'patron' (customer/sponsor) is not standard for Dutch 'patroon' and is mostly covered by 'boss' and 'patron saint', so it is confusing.

The patron saint is called 'de patroonheilige' or 'patroon' only in a narrow sense; here the entry is a rare use and confusing, but also de patroon (patron saint) is attested; dropping as it overlaps with boss/patron meanings.
This meaning is a vulgar slur-like insult in dialect spelling, unsuitable for learners and duplicates the vulgar sense already listed.
to appoint is not a real meaning of creëren; the other listed senses (create, establish, cause) already cover it.
'Fin' is not a meaning of toren (the word for fin is vin), and tower and rook are already listed.
'Dirtbag' is the same sense as the 'asshole' meaning (a despicable man), so it duplicates item 2.
'Gross person' is essentially the same sense as the 'asshole' meaning (a creep or lecher), so it duplicates item 2.
to envision is essentially the same as "to foresee", which is already listed, so this duplicates another meaning and is not a distinct sense of voorzien.
to facilitate is not a real meaning of voorzien; the sense of supplying is already covered by "to provide".
